title: Curious If Anyone Experienced This
content: I lucid dream a lot and have had vivid dreams since childhood. Once I start dream, even if I wake up, I still go back to it during the night. I know I'm dreaming. I have had only one dream that hurt me in my dream and actually caused me real pain in real life because as kid I learned to hit a pause button, wake up, go back in, rewind, start again. End of last year I have a couple dreams that took me to a mall but the mall was being destroyed by storm, it was a tornado with hurricane winds. There's always a kind person in my dreams, I can't remember his face when I wake up or I should say, it's like there's a filter over it because I never met him irl but he tries to help me out of the the storms and he has tried to guide me to the right buses (I have bus dreams that tell me something about my journey in life). So this dream was actually weird because it's the first time anyone told me they were awake in the dream world too. Ive always been alone when I'm awake. But this time the dream showed me also, the watchers of dreams. Last year I had many dreams asking me to leave the reality and I always said okay. But then I got warning that I had someone actively trying to hold me back. I'm free from them now. So onto the dream in question. Dream: so the dream world was divided into "show" buildings and people got put into whatever roles the watchers wanted them into. I got dropped into one of the 90s medical ER shows that make you cringe but you keep watching it. It was like, House. So I wind up the patient who had been a nurse but suddenly lost the function of my legs. So the specialist gets called in to figure out the mystery of what's wrong and just like that he goes, draw some blood. I'm betting on a tick. Comes back positive for some made up, apparently super rare, tick born disease that causes paralysis. Doc comes to tell me and I'm like... That doesn't exist. He says yes it does, watch. Gives me a shot and says there, you can walk again. I legit pull out my phone and I'm like, no, that shit you just mentioned doesn't exist. I'll prove it. At that point, I look at my phone. Realize I can't read it. Suddenly go, oh, I'm dreaming. Well no wonder this shit ass doctor can make up whatever. The nurse next to me says, oh shit, you woke up too? Shhh. If they find out, you get kicked out. Want to join us and play games and learn how it works? I was like hell yes. He said, play the role or you'll get kicked out. So I get into the wheelchair like I'm still recovering and the doctor is smiling at himself like he saved the day. The guy I'm with wheels me into a big warehouse like part of the building where it's just full of unaware people slowly milling around. The guy told me they're on standby for parts to play. He then takes me to other people who also wake, I believe it was just a couple more, and we go to this backdoor and they show me other shows going on. There was a school one. Work ones. Stores, playgrounds. It was crazy. Of course, us going to other buildings I do think disrupted stuff because suddenly someone appeared in our building from the wrong time. Like he just fell asleep in real life and as he was being put into his building, we showed up and he materialized in front of us. But because we were there and we looked different in our clothing, it freaked him out. Us calming him down so he didn't alert the watchers woke him up. The guy was confused and scared and overwhelmed by all the technology and information and freaking out. So me and the group had to calm him down and try to hide him from the watchers by going back to our building to hide him better. Plus the watchers did a check in to make sure everyone was present in their building and the group had the time down. Of course the more overwhelming things got for him the more he regressed his age. We tried to tell him to stop before he disappeared but he said, he can't stop. He's not supposed to be here. He's not supposed to know this stuff. Then the building opened up and the watcher saw us. They reached in to grabbed him and when I saw the watchers' faces, I woke up. They weren't humans. They weren't even biological I think. I can't get the image out of my head. I wish I could remember what night I had this. It was last week because I told my coworker when I last saw him and I last saw him, Saturday. I suffer from time blindness it feels like. One year feels like four years for me. Also, the more vivid dreams I have, the longer time feels. I have 22 year old that I feel like I had 60+ years ago. My youngest, 16, 40 something years ago. Trust, no complaints on my part. I love my time blindness. I noticed so much, time moves slowly for me. But it frustrates people who want to ask when something happened. Idk. Maybe yesterday, maybe a week ago. I can tell you everything that happened though.
